{{recipe}}

'''Fried Cassava''', also known as '''Kuwese U Logo''' in Tiv. It is prepared from cassava.

==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:Cassava|Cassava]]
*Pepper
*[[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|Groundnut oil]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste

==Procedure==
#Cut cassava into your desired size and shape, then rinse with water. Dry well.
#Blend pepper and pour on sliced cassava. [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] to coat.
#Heat the oil in a deep [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]].
#[[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|Deep-fry]] the cassava in the hot oil until tender.
#Remove from the oil and serve hot, sprinkled with salt.
